scripts.android:add: npm run configure && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run configure && cap sync android
scripts.windows:build: npm run check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never --config desktop/builder.json
scripts.check: node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check desktop/preload.cjs && node --check desktop/launcher.js && node config.test.cjs && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.windows:portable: npm run check && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never --config desktop/builder.json
